name: JetBlue
note: JetBlue's bag fee moves on four axes at once: fare brand, route, peak vs off-peak date, and whether you pay more than 24 hours before departure. The block below is the single most common case — Blue/Blue Basic/Blue Extra, US and nearby, off-peak, prepaid. Every other combination costs more and is listed in the caveats.

baggage.label: Checked bags, US and nearby, off-peak, prepaid
caveats: Blue, Blue Basic, Blue Extra and EvenMore fares within the US, Latin America, Caribbean and Canada. Off-peak dates, paid more than 24 hours before departure.
Paying inside 24 hours costs more: 49 USD first bag, 69 USD second. Prepaying saves up to 10 USD per bag.
Peak dates cost more again. JetBlue publishes the peak calendar, and it covers most of June, July and August 2026, plus Thanksgiving and the winter holidays.
Transatlantic is a different schedule entirely: Blue Basic pays 75 USD first bag off-peak, while Blue, Blue Plus, Blue Extra and EvenMore include the first bag free.
Blue Plus includes the first bag. Mint includes two bags at 70 lb. Mosaic 2-4 includes two bags.
JetBlue Plus and Premier cardholders get the first bag free on JetBlue-operated flights only. Codeshares and partner-operated flights are excluded.
Oversize (63-80 in) is 150 USD and overweight (51-99 lb) is 150 USD, and they stack: a bag that is both pays both. Over 80 in or over 99 lb is refused.
Ecuador, Dominican Republic, Guyana, Haiti and Trinidad & Tobago each carry their own bag limits and lower weight ceilings.
Bag fees are refundable only if the entire booking is cancelled before departure.
